transport: All compiler responses simulated in this edge-case suite; live checks are in coding-browser-results.json.
results: A checked solution and the solved count persist through reload.
Export and restore preserve code, input, selected question, and passing state.
Reset learning progress clears passing records while retaining coding drafts.
Program output is escaped as text; changing stdin marks a run result as stale.
Rate-limit feedback preserves code and offers a retry.
Malformed service responses never count as a successful run.
Stop waiting cancels the client request and explains its remote limitation.
Switching questions cancels waiting and prevents another question from receiving a stale response.
Reference solution loads explicitly; Tab indents and Shift+Tab leaves the editor.
